title: Real-exchange-rate (PPP-deviation) band-reversion at monthly decision cadence

mechanism.statement: When the nominal exchange rate is more than 2% away from its purchasing-power parity level (relative-PPP real exchange rate measured against a trailing 3-year anchor), the undervalued currency tends to appreciate and the overvalued currency tends to depreciate over the following month - real-exchange-rate mean reversion. This is a pure price-level-differential mechanism: it contains NO interest-rate input of any kind, so it is axis-2 core with zero axis-1 overlap.

construction.log_price_s(pair,t): log of the pair's daily FX price snapshot series (base currency per 1 quote-unit convention of the authorized snapshot)
construction.log_price_level_P(area,t): log of the area's monthly CPI index level, read from the evidenced vintage as-of decision time t (most recent print whose evidenced availability stamp <= decision event; observed once, replay never)
construction.anchor_Q(pair,t): trailing 756-session (about 3 years) rolling mean of q computed on the same as-of reads
construction.band: 2.0% (single frozen value), in log points x100
construction.state_rule: SHORT base vs quote when q >= Q + 0.02 (base real-overvalued, expect reversion down); LONG base vs quote when q <= Q - 0.02 (base real-undervalued); flat inside the band

mechanism.honest_effect_size_disclosure: Rogoff's consensus half-life for real-exchange-rate reversion is 3-5 years. Under a 4-year half-life and an entry-deviation of 4-6%, the expected per-month drift is roughly 7-11 bps against 3.0 bps base round-trip cost - positive on paper, but estimated with a per-month FX standard deviation of 500-700 bps, i.e. the signal-to-noise per trade is ~0.01-0.02. The mechanism is preregistered BECAUSE it is the canonical axis-2 hypothesis, with the explicit expectation that it may fail every thin-margin gate; a correct negative is a successful result (P-6).
mechanism.why_this_is_NOT_a_carry_or_momentum_rela: the signal contains only exchange-rate LEVEL relative to price LEVELS; no rate, no momentum, no session structure, no volatility gate. Its neighbour and placebo arms preserve that purity (see arms).

falsifiable_prediction.primary: Positions taken per the state rule have strictly positive after-cost expectancy on the financing-adjusted book at monthly cadence over the scored window, and at least 2 of 3 populated time folds are positive.
falsifiable_prediction.secondary_falsifiable_form: the per-trade mean return of band-entry positions is positive at ALL of base, x1.5, x2.0 cost tiers (stress applied to booked PnL); failure at tier 2.0 falsifies the claim that PPP reversion is economically tradeable under the frozen cost authority even if the base-tier sign is positive
falsified_if_any: anchor fin-adj expectancy <= 0 at base tier
fewer than 2 of 3 populated folds positive

stale-mismatch placebo control reproduces the anchor's gate outcome with >= 90% decision overlap -> the price-level leg is inert and the observed trades are nominal-FX momentum in disguise -> family FAILS

literature.citation: Rogoff, K. (1996), 'The Purchasing Power Parity Puzzle', Journal of Economic Literature 34(2), 647-668
literature.role: canonical statement of real-exchange-rate mean reversion and its slow consensus half-life (3-5 years); source of this packet's honest effect-size arithmetic

literature.citation: Lothian, J.R. and Taylor, M.P. (1996), 'Real Exchange Rate Behavior: The Recent Float from the Perspective of the Past Two Centuries', Journal of Political Economy 104(3), 488-509
literature.role: long-sample evidence that PPP reversion operates over multi-year horizons on major-currency pairs

literature.citation: Froot, K.A. and Rogoff, K. (1995), 'Perspectives on PPP and Long-Run Real Exchange Rates', Handbook of International Economics, vol. 3
literature.role: survey grounding the real-rate construction and the slow-reversion consensus

literature.citation: Mussa, M. (1986), 'Nominal Exchange Rate Regimes and the Behavior of Real Exchange Rates: Evidence and Implications', Carnegie-Rochester Conference Series on Public Policy 25, 117-214
literature.role: documents large, persistent real-exchange-rate swings under floating - the source of the band widths this mechanism trades against

literature.citation: Meese, R.A. and Rogoff, K. (1983), 'Empirical exchange rate models of the seventies: Do they fit out of sample?', Journal of International Economics 14(1-2), 3-24
literature.role: sober prior on fundamental-model predictability; motivates the thin-margin expectations

pit_observable.note: availability evidence absolute (P-1); as of this packet the CPI leg has NO per-print evidence, hence data_blocked = true

conditioning_series.evidence_class: authorized snapshot, 152/152 byte-identity vs V3R tree (P2 authority); used for s_t, the anchor Q, execution, and the USD benchmark

conditioning_series.series: BIS WS_LONG_CPI monthly CPI index levels, areas US/EMU/GB/JP/CH/CA/AU/NZ
conditioning_series.evidence_class_required: per-print official release-calendar evidence with precision INSTANT (official timestamp) or DAY (date-only; operative at end of announcement UTC day, never earlier); one ledger row per print, archive-hashed

decision_clock.event: for each pair, the first FX session whose 16:00 America/New_York decision timestamp (DST-aware: 20:00 UTC EDT / 21:00 UTC EST) falls strictly after BOTH areas' latest CPI print evidenced availability stamps, and at least one full session after each print (one-event-lag rule)
decision_clock.read_rule: each conditioning series read exactly once per decision event as-of its evidenced stamps; observed-once / replay-never

warmup.macro: at least 37 monthly evidenced CPI prints per area (3 years) before the anchor Q is computable, plus full policy-free macro independence (this family uses no rates at all)
warmup.argument: the anchor is a 3-year mean; a 756-session FX warmup and 37 prints keep the start date print-availability-independent
warmup.scored_window: first post-warmup monthly decision through 2026-09; approximately 57 monthly decision events per pair expected (93-month window minus 36-month warmup)

holding_period.exit_conditions: expiry at 21 sessions, or early exit when q re-crosses toward Q by at least half the entry deviation at a decision event; fill next session
holding_period.forced_flat: force-flat at fold boundaries per inherited convention

entry_exit_rules.entry: at each monthly decision event per pair, when flat: enter per the state rule (SHORT base if q >= Q + 0.02; LONG base if q <= Q - 0.02); if already positioned and the band state persists, hold; if the band state flips, exit and allow opposite entry
entry_exit_rules.exit: per holding_period exit conditions; fill next session

fill_convention.fill: next-session bar: fills on the first FX session bar strictly after the decision event's 16:00-NY timestamp
fill_convention.validator_constraint: if no session starts within 4 calendar days of the decision event the decision is recorded INVALIDATED_NO_SESSION with NO fill (never late-filled); because every decision already lags its conditioning prints by >= 1 full session, no arm - anchor, neighbour, placebo, or benchmark - can emit a fill violating the one-event-lag or 4-day next-session constraints; all control books run to completion by construction (P-3 / FX-C4)
fill_convention.no_lookahead: P(area,t) uses only CPI vintages whose evidenced availability stamps precede the decision event

anchor.spec: mechanism above, single frozen parameter set
anchor.decisions: monthly, first post-print session 16:00-NY per pair

neighbour.one_presumption_away: anchor-window presumption only: anchor mean window 756 -> 504 sessions (about 2 years); band, holding, fills, semantics unchanged
neighbour.gate_role: neighbour supports the anchor if per-pair expectancy sign rank-agreement holds; need not pass every gate

control.role: placebo-style causal control isolating the price-level channel
control.spec: identical machinery EXCEPT the quote-area price level is deliberately read 12 months stale: q_mismatch = s - [P(base,t) - P(quote,t-12m)] (both reads are evidenced and PIT-legal - older data is always safe to use, so the control RUNS TO COMPLETION under evidenced semantics). This destroys the true purchasing-power comparison while preserving every mechanical property (band crossings, holding, fills, costs) via the nominal FX path alone
control.preregistered_non_reproduction_rule: the control must (i) differ from the anchor in at least 3 of 7 pairs by at least one entry date, AND (ii) not pass the anchor's full Stage-A gate set. If it reproduces the anchor's pass/fail status with >= 90% decision overlap, the price-level information is inert - the book is nominal FX dynamics wearing a PPP label - and the family FAILS the causal gate regardless of raw PnL
control.runs_to_completion_guarantee: all control inputs are legal evidenced reads; fills satisfy the same validator constraints as the anchor; no refused-by-construction arm

incremental_benchmark.spec: usd_drift_63d_benchmark_v1: at each decision event, hold every pair in the sign of the trailing 63-session USD index drift (USD index computed in-runner from the authorized 7-pair snapshot, inherited H2 fix), 21-session holding, identical fills and costs

incremental_test.alpha_definition: a5_ppp_per_pair_month_normalized_v1: expectancy(anchor, fin-adj, per pair per month in position) - expectancy(benchmark, fin-adj, per pair per month in position), pair-weighted aggregate; gate: overall incremental alpha > 0
incremental_test.rationale: band-entry PPP positions in USD-quote pairs are dominated by USD cycles; the USD-drift benchmark absorbs the shared direction so the gate prices in only the reversion term
incremental_test.dual_book: financing-adjusted book governs; price-only reported, must not invert sign

costs.application: F1-fixed multipliers applied to BOOKED stress PnL; tier 2.0 is a primary Stage-A gate
costs.break_even_bps: break-even bps per fill reported per cell (mandatory)

turnover_and_sample_floor.definition_of_decision: one decision event per pair per month; a trade = one entry fill + one exit fill
turnover_and_sample_floor.expected_decisions_per_arm: approximately 57 monthly events per pair over the scored window (93 months minus 36-month warmup)

expected_trades.anchor: band entries expected in 40-70% of pair-months -> 160-280 pair-month trades; band estimate depending on the (unwired) CPI path
expected_trades.control: same order of magnitude (mechanics preserved); decision-set overlap with the anchor is the measured quantity, not an assumption
expected_trades.benchmark: approximately 7 pairs x ~50 months = ~350 pair-month exposures

sample_floor.fold_population: >= 30 populated anchor trades per fold or the fold records NOT_POPULATED and fails the fold gate
sample_floor.band_caveat: counts depend on the unwired CPI path; a realized count below the floor is recorded SAMPLE_FLOOR_FAIL with no rescue

folds_plan.scheme: 3 equal chronological folds with force-flat boundaries and a 21-session purge gap
folds_plan.stage_a_note: gate: >= 2 of 3 populated folds positive (fin-adj); fold-positive share reported

drop_one_pair.procedure: 7 refits, one per pair dropped, anchor only, parameters untouched
drop_one_pair.gate: dropout survival >= 6 of 8 scenarios (7 pair-drops + best-fold-drop; inherited M1-DEV binding)
drop_one_pair.interpretation: dependence on any single pair is recorded as concentration fragility; the dropped pair identity is reported, never acted upon

drop_one_fold.interpretation: single-fold dependence is a fragility record with margin-to-fail reported

failure_interpretation.expectancy_nonpositive: PPP reversion is absent at the 1-month horizon net of costs - consistent with the Rogoff puzzle's own arithmetic (half-lives of years vs a monthly hold); recorded as a correct negative, no threshold/window/clock rescue
failure_interpretation.pf_below_1.10: the reversion term is too small against the frozen cost authority; recorded cost-dominated
failure_interpretation.stress_tier_fail: economics exist only unstressed; explicitly not a survivor
failure_interpretation.control_reproduces_anchor: the price-level leg is inert (nominal-FX momentum in disguise); family fails the causal gate and the finding is recorded as a mechanism-honesty result
failure_interpretation.sample_floor_fail: too few band events on the realized CPI path; recorded NOT_PROMOTABLE_DATA_SCARCITY (distinct from a scored rejection)
failure_interpretation.mdd_or_concentration_fail: risk-shape violation; no override regardless of PnL

source_to_test_map.test: only-availability-differs invariant vs raw series; per-area per-print availability-lag mutation tests: shifting any stamp forward must change the book, stamps cannot move backward
one-event-lag test: no decision may share a session with its conditioning print; 4-day next-session validator test with INVALIDATED_NO_SESSION path exercised
cost once per fill; tier multipliers reach booked stress PnL (P1-phase regression)
control-runs-under-evidenced-semantics: control book must execute with nonzero decisions; an empty/refused control book is a DESIGN FAILURE
8-scenario dropout, 3-fold force-flat, benchmark twin mechanics per inherited scored_runner conventions

margin_to_fail_expectations.note: outcome-blind ex-ante priors only; no PnL exists at D1

per_gate.expectancy_gt_0_fin_adj: HIGH FAILURE RISK by the packet's own arithmetic: expected reversion drift 2-12 bps per trade across plausible half-lives (3-10y) and entry deviations (4-8%), against 3.0 bps base cost; the point margin is expected to be a small fraction of one standard error
per_gate.folds_2of3_positive: moderate-high risk; reversion episodes cluster (e.g. 2021-22 inflation divergence) so fold heterogeneity is likely
per_gate.mdd_within_frozen_ceiling: LOW-moderate risk: 21-session holds, unit notional, 7 pairs
per_gate.pair_concentration_within_ceiling: moderate risk: wide real deviations may concentrate entries in 2-3 pairs for long stretches (e.g. JPY in 2022-24); this is the gate most likely to expose concentration besides stress
per_gate.stress_tier_1.5: HIGH failure risk given base margins near zero
per_gate.stress_tier_2.0_PRIMARY: HIGH failure risk - the most probable kill gate; with base expectancy < 3 bps the doubled-loss tier book is negative
per_gate.usd_drift_within_bounds: LOW risk; benchmark absorbs shared USD direction
per_gate.incremental_alpha_gt_0: HIGH failure risk: if band entries coincide with USD momentum phases, the benchmark-adjusted term vanishes
per_gate.control_does_not_reproduce: genuinely uncertain ex ante: in low-inflation subperiods (2019-20) the 12-month-stale price level barely moves q, so anchor/control overlap may be high WITHOUT invalidating the mechanism in the high-inflation subperiod; the preregistered rule (overlap >= 90% over the WHOLE window) is frozen anyway and accepted as stated, because a mechanism that cannot distinguish itself from its own stale-price twin across the full sample has no demonstrated price-level information

margin_to_fail_expectations.overall_prior: the modal ex-ante outcome is a scored negative or a tier/concentration kill; a base-tier pass would be recorded knife-edge with margin-to-fail per gate (P-2), and negative results are first-class closes (P-6)

constraint_compliance.no_new_data_sources: BIS WS_LONG_CPI already staged (P2 authority); evidence wiring uses the existing official-static-calendar ledger pattern; no new vendor/key/purchase

novelty_self_check.vs_V1_family1_session_open_momentum_cont: no intraday/session structures; monthly macro cadence; disjoint
novelty_self_check.vs_V3_family2_invalidated: zero interest-rate inputs - cannot be a carry descendant by construction; expects near-zero rho against both V3 family2 anchor variants
novelty_self_check.vs_FXFV4-A5-P1: P1 nets inflation AGAINST policy rates (real-differential class); P2 uses price LEVELS alone (PPP class) with no rate input; different clock (monthly vs daily), different arms, different failure modes
novelty_self_check.vs_naive_trend_following: band-entry against the recent nominal move, not with it; the stale-mismatch placebo is exactly the test that would expose disguised momentum
novelty_self_check.rescue_operations: none: no band, window, clock, pair-subset, sign-inversion or cost relief available under any outcome
